scholarships.title: Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship for Undergraduate Students (Embassy Recommendation)
scholarships.official_source: MEXT (Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology)

existing.description: Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship for students from abroad who want to study as undergraduate students at Japanese national universities, selected through the recommendation of a Japanese embassy or consulate general. Applicants first pass a First Screening (documents, written academic examinations and interview) at the diplomatic mission in their country, are recommended to MEXT, and then pass MEXT's Second Screening. The scholarship pays a monthly allowance of JPY 117,000, waives entrance examination, matriculation and tuition fees, and provides an economy-class airline ticket to Japan and, on return, back to the grantee's home country. The scholarship period is five years from April 2027 to March 2032 including one year of preparatory Japanese language education, or seven years for medicine, dentistry, veterinary medicine and six-year pharmacy courses.
eligibility: Nationality of a country that has diplomatic relations with Japan; Japanese nationals are not eligible, with a limited exception for dual nationals resident outside Japan who renounce Japanese nationality on arrival
One of the listed academic-background conditions, normally 12 years of schooling completed outside Japan by March 2027
Applicants must be willing to learn Japanese and be interested in Japan
In principle, applicants must be willing to carry out their academic studies in Japan in Japanese
Age limit in principle, as set out in section 5 of the application guidelines
Able in principle to arrive in Japan between 1 April 2027 and 7 April 2027, with departure from the home residence on or after 1 April 2027
existing.eligibility_summary: Applicants must hold the nationality of a country that has diplomatic relations with Japan and must not hold Japanese nationality at the time of application. They must satisfy one of the listed academic-background conditions (normally 12 years of schooling outside Japan, completed by March 2027), must be willing to learn Japanese and to study in Japanese in principle, and must in principle be within MEXT's eligible age limit. Grantees must be able to arrive in Japan between 1 April 2027 and 7 April 2027.
benefits: Supplemental regional allowance in specially designated regions
Full waiver of entrance examination, matriculation and tuition fees
Economy-class airline ticket to Japan and back to the home country
One year of preparatory Japanese language education where applicable
coverage: Supplemental regional allowance of JPY 2,000 or JPY 3,000 per month for study in specially designated regions
Waiver of entrance examination, matriculation and tuition fees at the university
One-way economy-class airline ticket from the grantee's country to Japan
Return economy-class airline ticket from Japan to the grantee's home country on graduation
requirements: Applications must be submitted to the Japanese diplomatic mission in the country of the applicant's nationality by that mission's designated deadline
Applicants must submit two application packets: one complete set of original documents and one complete set of copies
Document numbers 1 to 9 must be written in the upper right-hand corner of the first page of each document
Applicants must sit the First Screening written examinations and interview at the diplomatic mission
documents: Direct Placement Preference Form, submitted after the First Screening by eligible applicants
School records or academic transcripts showing grades and the grade scale used
Certificate of graduation from upper secondary school, or certificate of prospective graduation
Certificate of university enrollment where applicable
Japanese or English language proficiency certificates, if held (issued no earlier than two years before application)
existing.english_requirement: Applicants must in principle be willing to carry out their academic studies in Japan in Japanese. MEXT provides one year of preparatory Japanese language education before university enrolment for grantees who attend a preparatory educational institution. Japanese or English proficiency certificates are optional and must have been issued no earlier than two years before the date of application to the diplomatic mission.
application_method: Obtain the FY2027 application guidelines and forms from the Japanese diplomatic mission in the country of your nationality
Complete the Application Form and assemble the required supporting documents
Submit both the original set and the copy set to the diplomatic mission by its deadline
Sit the First Screening written examinations and interview at the diplomatic mission
Submit the Direct Placement Preference Form after passing the First Screening, if eligible
Await the final result, notified by the diplomatic mission after February 2027
existing.selection_notes: The Japanese diplomatic mission conducts the First Screening through examination of submitted documents, written academic examinations and interviews; MEXT then conducts the Second Screening of the recommended applicants and selects candidates from each course. Written examination subjects depend on the chosen field: Social Sciences and Humanities applicants take Japanese, English and Mathematics; Natural Sciences applicants take Japanese, English, Mathematics and either Chemistry or Physics. Reasons for screening results are not disclosed and objections to the decision on university placement are not accepted.
existing.best_fit: Students from countries with diplomatic relations with Japan who have completed about 12 years of schooling outside Japan and want an undergraduate place at a Japanese national university.
existing.notes: MEXT stipulates the travel schedule and route and issues the airline ticket; the grantee bears domestic travel to the nearest international airport, airport taxes, airport usage fees, special taxes, travel expenses within Japan, travel insurance and baggage costs. The grantee is recommended to bring at least about US$2,000 for immediate expenses on arrival, because the first scholarship instalment is paid one to one and a half months after arrival.
existing.duration: Five years from April 2027 to March 2032 including one year of preparatory Japanese language education; seven years for medicine, dentistry, veterinary medicine or a six-year pharmacy course; four years for grantees placed directly at a university
existing.application_period: Annually; the 2027 cycle guidelines were published by MEXT in April 2026 and applications were made to Japanese diplomatic missions during the first half of the year
existing.deadline_display: No single central date: applicants must submit to the Japanese diplomatic mission in the country of their nationality by the deadline that mission sets, and that date is not published by MEXT. MEXT states applicants are informed of the final selection result by their diplomatic mission after February 2027, and that grantees must in principle arrive in Japan between 1 April 2027 and 7 April 2027.

scholarships.title: Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship for Research Students (University Recommendation)
scholarships.official_source: MEXT (Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology)

existing.description: Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship for students from abroad who wish to pursue research study at a Japanese university under the university-recommendation route, meaning the accepting university nominates the student to MEXT. The monthly allowance depends on the course enrolled in: JPY 117,000 for regular students in bachelor degree courses, JPY 144,000 for master's or professional degree courses and JPY 145,000 for doctoral courses, with a supplemental regional allowance of JPY 2,000 or JPY 3,000 per month in specially designated regions. Entrance examination, matriculation and tuition fees must be paid by the accepting university, and MEXT stipulates the travel route and provides an economy-class airline ticket. The scholarship period is the necessary period for completion of the relevant regular course.
eligibility: Nominated by a Japanese accepting university under the university-recommendation route
Enrolled in a regular course corresponding to the level for which the scholarship is awarded (master's or professional degree course, or doctoral course)
Meets the nationality, age and academic-background conditions set out in the application guidelines
Able to arrive in Japan within the period designated by MEXT for the intake year

Applications for extension of the scholarship period due to advanced study are not acceptable for bachelor degree courses, preparatory education and bachelor degree courses, master's courses (doctoral course first phase), or professional degree courses
existing.eligibility_summary: International students seeking research study at a Japanese university who are nominated by that university under the university-recommendation route. MEXT's aim is to foster human resources who will become bridges of friendship between the grantee's country and Japan through study in Japan and who will contribute to the development of both countries and the wider world. Extensions of the scholarship period for advanced study are permitted for doctoral students in five-year doctoral courses and for master's courses progressing to the doctoral phase, but not for bachelor degree courses or for master's courses progressing to a professional degree course.
benefits: Monthly scholarship allowance up to JPY 145,000 for doctoral students
Supplemental regional allowance in specially designated regions
Entrance examination, matriculation and tuition fees covered by the accepting university
Economy-class airline ticket to Japan and back on completion of the course
coverage: Monthly scholarship allowance of JPY 144,000 for regular students in master's or professional degree courses
Monthly scholarship allowance of JPY 145,000 for regular students in doctoral courses
Monthly scholarship allowance of JPY 117,000 for regular students in bachelor degree courses
Supplemental regional allowance of JPY 2,000 or JPY 3,000 per month in specially designated regions
Entrance examination, matriculation and tuition fees paid by the accepting university
Economy-class airline ticket to Japan and, on completion, back to the grantee's home country
requirements: The student must be nominated by the accepting university; individual applicants cannot apply directly to MEXT under this route
Applications for extension of the scholarship period due to advanced study must be submitted; they are not automatic
MEXT stipulates the travel schedule and route; the airline ticket cannot be changed afterwards
MEXT will not provide an airline ticket for domestic recommenders
The grantee bears domestic travel to the nearest international airport, airport taxes, travel within Japan, travel insurance and baggage costs
documents: Certificate of enrollment or student status from the accepting university
Academic transcripts and degree certificate from the previous institution
Research plan or outline of the proposed research
Supervisor's acceptance, where required by the guidelines
Passport or other evidence of nationality
Documents as required by the nominating university
existing.english_requirement: Not applicable to the MEXT selection at this level: under the university-recommendation route admission is decided by the accepting university, which sets its own language requirements for the course. MEXT's guidelines for this route do not set an MEXT-level English or Japanese test requirement.
application_method: Identify a Japanese university that runs a university-recommendation nomination for this scholarship
Apply to that university in its own intake for international research students
The university nominates the student to MEXT within the annual nomination window
MEXT reviews the nominated candidates and confirms the award
The grantee accepts the terms, after which MEXT stipulates the travel schedule and issues the airline ticket
existing.selection_notes: MEXT's stated aim is to foster human resources who will become bridges of friendship between the grantee's country and Japan through study in Japan and who will contribute to the development of both countries and the wider world. Under the university-recommendation route the academic assessment is effectively the university's, with MEXT confirming the nominated candidates.
existing.best_fit: International Master's or doctoral candidates who can secure a nomination from a Japanese university through its international research-student admission route.
existing.notes: MEXT does not provide an airline ticket where the recommender is domestic (inside Japan). Grantees reapplying for the scholarship after their period ends in the Special Selection must take into account how the period is counted. If the university term begins in the middle of a month, the scholarship is not paid for that month.
existing.duration: The necessary period for the completion of the respective regular course; the guidelines note that for adopted five-year doctoral courses the first two years count as a master's course and years three to five as a doctoral course, so students must apply for extension when advancing to the third year
existing.application_period: Annual. MEXT publishes the guidelines for the coming year and calls universities for nominations; students apply through their prospective or current Japanese university rather than directly to MEXT
existing.deadline_display: No applicant-facing deadline is published. Under the university-recommendation route the accepting university nominates the student to MEXT, so the application timetable is set between MEXT and each university and is not announced publicly.
